senses.gloss: Ārdrā, a nakshatra. § 746 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 64, 3259 (Ārdrāyāṃ kṛsharaṃ dattvā tilamiśram uposhitaḥ|naras tarati durgāṇi kshuradhārāṃś ca parvatān).--§ 749 (do.): XIII, 89, 4257 (by performing a śrāddha under Ā. a man becomes a performer of fierce deeds--krūrakarmā).--§ 759 (do.): XIII, 110, 5395 (description of the candravrata).
